          insert into SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 values(i, mod(i,100)+1.123456||i, mod(i+1,2), 'V$SQLStatisticalaccumulation'||mod(i,100), concat('ABCDEFabcdef001',mod(i,100)));    
      end loop;    
      commit;    
  end;    
  /,CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE SR16641_accumulation_pro8(i INT) IS    
  BEGIN    
  CASE i    
  WHEN 1 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_int, s_int from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 right join SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 on c_int=s_int';    
  WHEN 2 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_clob, s_clob from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 full join SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 on c_clob like s_clob';    
  WHEN 3 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where c_var <= some(select s_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_2)';    
  WHEN 4 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_bool from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where c_bool != any(select s_bool from SR16641_accumulation_table8_2)';    
  WHEN 5 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_int from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where c_int in (select s_int from SR16641_accumulation_table8_2)';    
  WHEN 6 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where not exists (select * from SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where c_var = s_var)';    
  WHEN 7 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where c_var+null!=s_var union select cast(s_clob as varchar(100)) from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where s_clob like c_clob';    
  WHEN 8 THEN    
   execute immediate 'select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where c_var!=s_var minus all select cast(s_clob as varchar(100)) from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where s_clob||''110'' like c_clob||''110''';    
  WHEN 9 THEN    
   execute immediate 'insert into SR16641_accumulation_table8_1(c_bool) select c_bool from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where not exists (select * from SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where c_bool >= s_bool and s_int+s_doub>100)';    
  WHEN 10 THEN    
   execute immediate 'update SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 set c_var = ''abcabcabcabc123'' where c_var = (select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where c_var+null!=s_var union select cast(s_clob as varchar(100)) from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where s_clob||''110'' like c_clob)';    
  WHEN 11 THEN    
   execute immediate 'delete from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where c_var != all(select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 where c_var >= (with cte as(select s_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where s_var < c_var||''abc'' and s_var = ''V$SQLStatisticalaccumulation101'') select s_var from cte))';    
  WHEN 12 THEN    
   execute immediate 'merge into SR16641_accumulation_table8_1 t1     
  using SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 t2 on (t2.s_clob like t1.c_clob)     
    when matched    
      then update set t1.c_var = ''abcdef1234567''||''abc''    
    when not matched    
   then insert (c_var) values (concat(''ABCDEFabcdef001'',mod(1,100)))';     
  END CASE;    
  END SR16641_accumulation_pro8;    
  /,declare     
   n01 bigint := 0;     
   n02 bigint := 0;    
   n03 bigint := 0;    
   n1 bigint;    
   n2 bigint;    
   n3 bigint;    
  begin    
   for i in 1 .. 20 loop    
   SR16641_accumulation_pro8(7);    
   select EXECUTIONS, ELAPSED_TIME, BUFFER_GETS into n1, n2, n3 from V$SQL where SQL_TEXT like 'select c_var from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where c_var+null!=s_var union select cast(s_clob as varchar(100)) from SR16641_accumulation_table8_1, SR16641_accumulation_table8_2 where s_clob like c_clob';    
   if n1-n01>=1 then     
   n01 := n1;    
   dbms_output.put_line(n1);    
   else    
   dbms_output.put_line('被载入缓存库后的执行次数有误！');     
   end if;

   else     
   dbms_output.put_line('信息累计读缓存区次数有误！');     
   end if;     
   end loop;     
  end;
